description: Pilgrims' Facility and Landscape Improvement Project at Sellakatharagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to secure the funds required for the  implementation of a project to improve common amenities for pilgrims visiting Sellakatharagama and Landscape Improvement, was approved by the Cabinet.
